title: Build apple-ib-tb on kernel 6.12+ from Heratiki's fork
author: shawnyeager
body:
Pairs with [basecamp/omarchy#7064](https://github.com/basecamp/omarchy/pull/7064). That PR installs T1 firmware and the udev rebind; this package is what actually compiles `apple-ib-tb`.

Verified on MacBookPro14,3 / linux 7.1.8: the packaged `0+git.315` DKMS build fails, Heratiki's `touchbar-driver-hid-driver` builds `apple-ibridge` / `apple-ib-tb` / `apple-ib-als`, and the bar lights up after the iBridge is rebound.

`sync: false` so the next AUR pass does not put marc-git back.

files.patch:
@@ -2,24 +2,24 @@
 # Maintainer: Andrey Melentyev <andrey.melentyev@protonmail.com>
 _pkgbase=macbook12-spi-driver
 pkgname=(${_pkgbase}-dkms)
-pkgver=0+git.315
+# 316 = last AUR git-count plus the kernel 6.12+ build fix. Do not let
+# pkgver() recount Heratiki's history or the package goes backwards from 315.
+pkgver=0+git.316
 pkgrel=1
 pkgdesc="Driver for the keyboard, touchpad and touchbar found in newer MacBook (Pro) models"
 arch=('i686' 'x86_64')
-url="https://github.com/marc-git/macbook12-spi-driver"
+url="https://github.com/Heratiki/macbook12-spi-driver"
 license=('GPL2')
 depends=('dkms')
 makedepends=('git')
 optdepends=()
-source=(git+https://github.com/marc-git/macbook12-spi-driver.git#branch=touchbar-driver-hid-driver
+# marc-git's touchbar-driver-hid-driver does not build on kernel 6.11+:
+# platform .remove became void, hid report_fixup is const, acpi_driver.owner
+# is gone. Heratiki's fork is that branch plus those fixes.
+source=(git+https://github.com/Heratiki/macbook12-spi-driver.git#branch=touchbar-driver-hid-driver
         dkms.conf)
 sha256sums=('SKIP'
-            'e42243352d015a78e5d13260361d3052d0b84c4105bcb89191a319f2249cc47b')
-
-pkgver() {
-    cd $_pkgbase
-    echo "0+git.$(git rev-list HEAD --count)"
-}
+            'd1ebfc3b20ea6cc0454301e02d63eed32f808ff2d3f1ce1dcb60cf182cb92172')
 
 package() {
     install -dm755 "${pkgdir}"/usr/src/${_pkgbase}-${pkgver}

@@ -3,15 +3,14 @@ PACKAGE_VERSION="@PKGVER@"
 AUTOINSTALL="yes"
 CLEAN="make clean"
 
-BUILT_MODULE_NAME[0]="applespi"
-BUILT_MODULE_NAME[1]="apple-ibridge"
-BUILT_MODULE_NAME[2]="apple-ib-tb"
-BUILT_MODULE_NAME[3]="apple-ib-als"
+# applespi is in-tree since 5.3; the Heratiki Makefile only builds it on older
+# kernels, so listing it here makes DKMS fail on every current Omarchy kernel.
+BUILT_MODULE_NAME[0]="apple-ibridge"
+BUILT_MODULE_NAME[1]="apple-ib-tb"
+BUILT_MODULE_NAME[2]="apple-ib-als"
 MAKE[0]="make KDIR=/usr/lib/modules/$kernelver/build"
 MAKE[1]="make KDIR=/usr/lib/modules/$kernelver/build"
 MAKE[2]="make KDIR=/usr/lib/modules/$kernelver/build"
-MAKE[3]="make KDIR=/usr/lib/modules/$kernelver/build"
-DEST_MODULE_LOCATION[0]="/kernel/drivers/spi"
+DEST_MODULE_LOCATION[0]="/kernel/drivers/misc"
 DEST_MODULE_LOCATION[1]="/kernel/drivers/misc"
 DEST_MODULE_LOCATION[2]="/kernel/drivers/misc"
-DEST_MODULE_LOCATION[3]="/kernel/drivers/misc"
